verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Shortcut publishing its own MCP server that external clients such as Claude Code, Codex CLI and Cursor connect to. That is the server role, not this story's client role. Nothing documents Shortcut itself connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools. A project-management SaaS with built-in agents could plausibly offer this, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
